proposals.description: Die lernende Person kann Zusammensetzung, Konsum und Anwendung frei verkäuflicher Schmerzmittel recherchieren, Wirkstoff-Moleküle wie Acetylsalicylsäure, Ibuprofen und Paracetamol anhand chemischer Strukturmerkmale einordnen und die Anwendung der Schmerzmittel anhand der recherchierten Informationen zur Chemie der Wirkstoffe bewerten.
proposals.descriptionEn: The learner can research the composition, consumption, and use of over-the-counter analgesics, classify active ingredient molecules such as acetylsalicylic acid, ibuprofen, and paracetamol by chemical structural features, and evaluate the use of the analgesics using the researched information about the chemistry of their active ingredients.
proposals.reason: The complete BY C11.3.4 competency explicitly requires evaluating application, beyond researching use and classifying structure. Its current direct mapping has only this goal as partner, so no partner supplies the missing operator. Both actual existing cases already request application evaluation. Add the actual operator without new clinical/patient advice or an example quota.

proposals.description: Die lernende Person kann die unterschiedliche Reaktivität vergleichbarer Aldehyde und Ketone bei der nucleophilen Addition unter gleichen Reaktionsbedingungen anhand elektronischer und sterischer Einflüsse mechanistisch begründen.
proposals.descriptionEn: The learner can mechanistically explain differences in the reactivity of comparable aldehydes and ketones toward nucleophilic addition under the same reaction conditions using electronic and steric effects.
proposals.reason: General aldehyde/ketone reactivity is ambiguous across oxidation, reduction, addition and media. The actual two complete cases compare nucleophilic addition under controlled conditions and explicitly defeat a universal aldehyde-before-ketone rule. Bound the intended mechanism and comparability instead of claiming a universal reaction ranking.
